# Dakio

> Dakio is one app to run a whole business, for shops and service businesses everywhere: website, inbox, orders, bookings, customers, quotes, invoices and money, with Nova, an AI CEO, in every part. Shops get products, stock, orders and couriers; service businesses (parlours, salons, coaching centres, chambers, photographers, repair, events) get bookings, a team calendar, reminders, quotes and invoices; a business can do both. In Bangladesh it also has the storefront checkout, couriers, bKash, Nagad and cash on delivery built in; outside Bangladesh the inbox, Nova, bookings and customer records work today, paid in US dollars. Nova runs the day to day inside limits the owner sets; prices, discounts, refunds and anything risky stay the owner's call. Built by Digidhaka Communication Limited (Dhaka, Bangladesh). Plans are in taka in Bangladesh and in US dollars elsewhere; every plan includes Nova.

## Pages

- [Home](https://dakio.io/): Run your whole business from one app, with Nova, an AI CEO, built in.
- [For shops](https://dakio.io/shops): Missed messages, fake orders, couriers, repeat buyers, profit, a website and selling without stock, each answered with a real app screen.
- [For services](https://dakio.io/services): Missed bookings, no shows, the team's day, getting paid, client pages and enquiries, each answered with a real app screen.
- [Nova](https://dakio.io/nova): Nova is the AI CEO of your business: it answers customers, books clients, takes orders and follows up, inside the limits you set.
- [Front Office](https://dakio.io/front-office): One inbox for Messenger, Instagram, WhatsApp and website chat; Nova answers in Bangla or English.
- [Themes](https://dakio.io/themes): Ready storefront designs for each kind of shop, each becoming your own website.
- [Ads Studio](https://dakio.io/ads): Pick a product, get an editable ad in three sizes, static and motion.
- [Switch](https://dakio.io/switch): Move from Shopify to Dakio in one weekend.
- [Developers](https://dakio.io/developers): @dakio/sdk to build your own React or Next.js storefront on Dakio's backend.
- [Pricing](https://dakio.io/pricing): Plans with Nova included on every tier, no hidden fees.

## Languages

Every marketing page exists in English and Bangla. English keeps the bare paths
(https://dakio.io/pricing); Bangla is the same page under /bn
(https://dakio.io/bn/pricing). The two are linked by hreflang, and English is
x-default. The Bangla is written as Bangla marketing copy rather than translated
from the English, so the pages make the same argument in different words.

Blog articles are Bangla-native and canonical under /bn/blog. Legal pages
(privacy, terms, refund policy, data deletion) exist in English only and the
English version governs.

## What is Nova?

Nova is the AI CEO inside every Dakio business. It answers customers in chat and comments, offers free times and records bookings, takes orders after the customer confirms, follows up quiet chats, and briefs the owner every morning. Every action leaves a receipt the owner can check. Nova never records money as received by itself: when a customer says they paid, it goes to the owner to confirm. Prices, discounts, refunds and risky decisions stay with the owner.

## Developer docs

English-only reference for @dakio/sdk (npm) and the HTTP API at https://dakio-api-production.up.railway.app/api/sdk/v1:

- [Quickstart](https://dakio.io/developers/docs): a test key, `npm install @dakio/sdk`, products on screen, a test order.
- [Keys & security](https://dakio.io/developers/docs/keys): client keys (dk_pub_, browser-safe, domain-locked), secret keys (dk_sec_, server only), limits.
- [Bag, quote & checkout](https://dakio.io/developers/docs/checkout): prices only from quotes; COD checkout; the SMS code step; Idempotency-Key.
- [React](https://dakio.io/developers/docs/react), [Next.js](https://dakio.io/developers/docs/nextjs), [Webhooks](https://dakio.io/developers/docs/webhooks), [Secret keys](https://dakio.io/developers/docs/secret-keys), [HTTP API](https://dakio.io/developers/docs/api), [Going live](https://dakio.io/developers/docs/going-live).
